defect.observed: Stock Generic feels difficult to control and slides at speed
defect.expected: A new player can drive a complete valid lap with the initial car and default assists, without buying upgrades

findings.hypothesis: Excessive high-speed steering lock amplifies full digital key commands
findings.evidence: At 200 km/h, a 0.65-second full key hold gives about 7.42 degrees of wheel steering with the legacy curve; corrected production prefab gives about 1.26 degrees. Measured slip drops from 11.88 to 4.71 degrees in the same manoeuvre. The baseline reproduced excessive slide, not a full 360-degree spin.

findings.hypothesis: Tire grip, engine power or chassis forces need a broad retune
findings.evidence: The isolated curve change reduces slip and permits a valid physical lap. All other serialized physics and RCCP component values are unchanged in nine prefab assets.

findings.hypothesis: Additional steering rack slowdown is necessary
findings.evidence: The initial three-profile experiment in BeforeAssetFix.json found no material improvement over the curve change alone; no dynamic rack override or extra stabilizing force was added.

findings.hypothesis: Natural finish creates RCCP_AI before its navigation agent is prepared
findings.evidence: KeyboardLap-BeforeFinishAgentFix.json records a valid lap followed by SetDestination errors. Finish now calls the existing FormulaSession.PrepareAgent path before adding AI. Final full-lap run includes a two-second bound-agent/AI-profile check and no errors.

changes: Speed-sensitive steering curve saved to eight Generic livery prefabs and the runtime vehicle prefab; matching authoring builder retains the correction on rebuild
RCCP autonomous vehicles explicitly retain their previous analog steering calibration when PrepareAgent is called, including the post-finish takeover
Post-finish AI navigation is bound before RCCP_AI is enabled
Editor-only regression tools use temporary saves; no test driver is included in runtime builds

validation.preserved: Prefab GUIDs, all non-input MonoBehaviour fields, wheel colliders, tire curves, suspension, engine/gearbox/differential, aero, assists and Rigidbody physics; Unity serializer field renames normalized

fullLap.method: Automated binary W/A/S/D route follower through Input System; no AI during the timed lap, no transport, velocity writes or scripted finish; normal AI takeover after crossing the line

aiSmoke.method: Four-car Quick Race: actual player/AI steering profiles and eight seconds of opponent physics/navigation

validation.compilation: Final runtime and Editor assemblies compiled; final graphical Editor runs captured no errors
validation.diagnosticHistory: BeforeAssetFix.json contains the initial 27-sample comparison. AIProfiles-StationaryGridProbe.json was inconclusive because the player was left stationary on the grid; the final smoke test drives the player and records individual opponent movement/navigation.

limitations: Full-key flat-road comparisons use controlled initial velocities; they are not natural acceleration-to-260-km/h tests
The valid lap uses an automated binary keyboard route follower, not a human play-feel review. It uses real input actions/physics/checkpoints/finish without transport or scripted completion
The complete lap covers Grand Prix Circuit; all 18 circuits, analog controller feel and Switch hardware were not exhaustively retested in this correction
